assumptions.short_sessions: At 15:45 mark at last available trade; an early holiday close is a stale-price estimate, not an executable 15:45 fill
assumptions.entry: Direction change in indicated direction, next observed trade tick
assumptions.exit: Arm on position-direction TrendOvershootExtended; exit first ordinary or overshoot reversal in that excursion, next observed tick; DC resets arm
assumptions.hold: Ignore further DC while holding; an overshoot in a later same-direction excursion also exits
assumptions.reverse: Opposite DC closes and reverses at next observed tick
assumptions.exit_dc: First opposite DC closes at next tick; consume that DC for exit only; wait for a subsequent new DC to enter; overshoot exit must belong to entry excursion
assumptions.session: 09:45 <= entry <15:45 New York; flatten at15:45 using last price observable at/before cutoff
assumptions.daily_loss_rule: Count all closed trades with negative gross P&L, regardless of exit reason; gains and flats do not reset the count; stop new entries after limit; reset each NY trade date
assumptions.risk: No DC-return exit; one position; no fees, quote spread or latency
